algorithm: In order K22,C22,M5,M6, draw one-based UHO line ordinals without replacement with Python random.Random(cell_seed).sample. Accept in sample order after first-four-field exclusion against every archived PGN FEN, Job 3 start FEN, Astra5 guard-game FEN, and earlier accepted line. Preserve source text with an LF delimiter. Initial sample size is twice the requested count plus 32. If exhausted, restart deterministically with twice the sample size.

historical.glob: job*/raw/**/*.pgn under forge-combo29/sol for jobs 1 through 31, including each D2s, M3 and M3b shard
historical.scope: All FEN tags, including controls, cut matches and unfinished games
